target_customer: Data engineers at companies with data pipelines
problem: Engineers lose time diagnosing broken data pipelines. Datamode aimed to be a single starting point for investigation to cut time to diagnosis.

founders.name: Andrew Kim
founders.background_notes: Only founder on the YC page. CB Insights people page names Vaughn Koch, a conflict not resolved.

competitors.name: Databand
competitors.funding_then: Seed round dated 2019-03-31 by CB Insights, other source says Blumberg led a 2018 seed, amount undisclosed

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs integrations across orchestration tools and lineage inference, moderate for one engineer.

defensibility.rationale: Open source and funded tools targeted the same problem, and integrations could be copied.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later funded observability firms such as Monte Carlo and Databand grew. Their dates relative to Datamode are not established.

market_need_then: Data pipeline reliability pain is stated in the YC pitch. No dated evidence of customer spend found.

branding.domain_note: A 1992 and 2007 trademark exist for Data Modes, Inc., whether tied to the domain is unknown

brand_strength.rationale: No sources about the brand were found, and the name resembles an unrelated older software trademark.

outcome_analysis: Datamode was a one person W19 data pipeline diagnosis tool that took a YC investment of about $150k per CB Insights. YC lists it as inactive but no post mortem, shutdown date or cause was found, so the cause is not public in the sources found.
notes: Funding rests on one database, CB Insights, which reports $150K over 2 rounds with YC as investor in March 2019; the second round is unknown. CB Insights names Vaughn Koch as founder, conflicting with YC. No company site is listed, so site status unknown. CB Insights pages could not be opened directly (403), figures come from search snippets.
